search_real_time.title: Search a real-time AI model
search_real_time.description: Ask one of Dappier's real-time AI models a question and get a synthesised answer back. Which data the model reaches -- live web, breaking news, stock prices, a publisher's own archive -- is a property of the model id, not of the request, so choosing the right `ai_model_id` from the Dappier marketplace is the whole configuration.

ai_model_id.description: The AI model to query, starting with `am_`. Browse them in the Dappier marketplace.

query.description: The question or query text to send to the model.

output.description: The model's answer, as a `message` string.

get_ai_recommendations.title: Get AI article recommendations
get_ai_recommendations.description: Semantic article search against a Dappier data model. `query` takes a natural-language question, a keyword, or a url -- given a url, Dappier reads the page, summarises it and recommends articles related to its content, which is what powers "related reading" on an article page.

data_model_id.description: The data model to search, starting with `dm_`. Browse them in the Dappier marketplace.

query.description: A natural-language query, a keyword, or a url to find related articles for.

ref.description: A domain to prefer results from, where the model supports it.

num_articles_ref.description: How many of the returned articles must come from `ref`.

output.description: The recommended articles, each with its title, url, summary and relevance score.

get_ask_ai_analytics.title: Get Ask AI analytics
get_ask_ai_analytics.description: Engagement rollup for the tenant's Ask AI widgets -- summary KPIs plus a daily time series, matching the Dappier dashboard for the same filters. Omitting either date defaults *both* to the trailing seven days, and an explicit range may not exceed 365 days.

start_date.description: Inclusive start of the window, YYYY-MM-DD UTC.

end_date.description: Inclusive end of the window, YYYY-MM-DD UTC.

widget_id.description: Restrict to one widget. Validated against the key's tenant.

creative_id.description: Filter by the creative id the widget was loaded with.

line_item_id.description: Filter by the line item id the widget was loaded with.

publisher_id.description: Filter by the publisher id the widget was loaded with.

get_ask_ai_logs.title: Get Ask AI conversation logs
get_ask_ai_logs.description: Raw Ask AI conversation rows, newest first -- the record-level view behind the analytics rollup. Use this to inspect individual conversations; use the analytics tool for aggregates. `limit` defaults to 50 and is silently clamped at 500.

start_date.description: Inclusive start of the window, YYYY-MM-DD UTC.

end_date.description: Inclusive end of the window, YYYY-MM-DD UTC.

interaction_type.description: Which interaction types to include. Defaults to free_form, automated_followup and search.

limit.description: Rows per page. Defaults to 50, clamped to 500.

get_sponsored_conversations_analytics.title: Get sponsored conversations analytics
get_sponsored_conversations_analytics.description: Advertiser-facing rollup for the campaigns this API key's tenant owns -- summary KPIs, a daily timeline, and per-campaign, per-prompt and per-click-type breakdowns. This is the endpoint for sponsored-conversation performance; the Ask AI analytics deliberately exclude it.

start_date.description: Inclusive start of the window, YYYY-MM-DD UTC.

end_date.description: Inclusive end of the window, YYYY-MM-DD UTC.

get_session_intelligence.title: Get session intelligence
get_session_intelligence.description: One aggregated payload describing how end users behave in a publisher's Ask AI widgets -- summary KPIs, engagement time, intent breakdown, top queried topics, content-category mix and query-depth distribution. The whole Session Intelligence dashboard in a single call.

start_date.description: Inclusive start of the window, YYYY-MM-DD UTC.

end_date.description: Inclusive end of the window, YYYY-MM-DD UTC.
